verdict.rationale: Godot documents its own programmatic surfaces that cover much of the editor UI. EditorInterface can save and reload scenes and inspect and edit resources, EditorScript and editor plugins script in-editor functionality, and the CLI is described as letting you work entirely from the command line, including headless automation. No evidence shows full parity between the API and everything the UI can do, and there is no OpenAPI spec or official MCP surface. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity guarantee or coverage mapping, an external or remote control API (no official MCP or OpenAPI), independent hands-on corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
